entries.45ffc890e8bdb352: This is a single-segment business that provides a reservation platform for comprehensive medical checkups and health examinations, and reservation systems for medical facilities, corporations and government bodies. The group consists of the company and 1 consolidated subsidiary (MRSO ASIA Co.,Ltd., Hanoi, Vietnam). Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,078 million, and the number of consolidated employees was 25. Sales are managed by category according to the services provided: "Reservations," "Advertising," "DX" and "Vaccines." The WEB reservation system for vaccination has effectively ended its provision as local governments' vaccination programs have ended.
entries.5dbcc8bb8ae1d2b0: This business expands the exposure of medical facilities through feature pages on 'MRSO.jp' and the like, and carries out promotions on 'MRSO.jp' through partnerships with companies.
entries.6d21fb112444a915: This consists of providing WEB reservation systems that contribute to operational efficiency, including "MRSO-Plus," a cloud-based checkup reservation management service for medical facilities, "Health Plus," a checkup operations support service for health insurance societies and companies, the health management DX service "MRSO Business," and WEB reservation systems for resident health checkups for municipalities. Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥163 million.
entries.7e0d2f3cf9885840: A company that operates "MRSO.jp," a reservation site for comprehensive medical checkups and health examinations, and a reservation system for medical facilities, advancing the digitalization of preventive medicine.
entries.9a59ce8945465551: This consists of marketing support for medical facilities through "MRSO.jp," a reservation site for comprehensive medical checkups and health examinations, and the provision of "MRS," a WEB reservation system for comprehensive medical checkups and health examinations installed on medical facilities' websites. As of the end of December 2025, plans from 1,906 medical facilities are listed on "MRSO.jp." Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥609 million.

entries.d8a45f87f28d2090: This business expands the exposure of medical facilities through feature pages on 'MRSO.jp' and the like, and carries out promotions on 'MRSO.jp' through partnerships with companies. It also operates 'Ningen Dock no Mikata', a physician-supervised information site. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥304 million.
entries.fe7bd197bf6e1101: This is the provision of WEB reservation systems for novel coronavirus vaccination and similar purposes. Because local governments' vaccination programs ended following changes in the national vaccination policy, provision of the service has effectively ended, and its share of sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was only 0.1%.
